name: Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor
summary: Warden Thelwater seals a report about a visitor to Bazil Thredd in the Stormwind Stockade. The confidential account helps track a covert operative moving through Stormwind's political and criminal spheres.

sections.title: A Mysterious Patron
sections.body: Prisoner Bazil Thredd spent years in the Stockade without a visitor. Then a quiet man began coming once or twice each week, carrying valid identification papers under the name Maelik. Warden Thelwater took note of the unusual visits and wrote down the man's appearance. He sealed the description so no meddling eyes could read it before proper investigators acted.

sections.title: From Stonemasons to Spies
sections.body: City architect Baros Alexston found no clear match in the description, though he suspected the visitor might be tied to the Defias rebellion. Alexston sent the sealed envelope to Master Mathias Shaw, who leads Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7. Shaw recognized the man as a lethal mercenary who uses names including Marzon and now does dirty work for Lord Gregor Lescovar.

faq.answer: Warden Thelwater, head warden of the Stormwind Stockade, wrote and sealed the document. He grew suspicious when an unknown man began visiting the imprisoned Defias leader, Bazil Thredd, regularly.

faq.q: Who is the visitor described in the paper?
faq.answer: The visitor used papers bearing the name Maelik. Warden Thelwater recorded his appearance so investigators could identify him.

faq.q: Why was the visitor meeting with Bazil Thredd?
faq.answer: Thelwater grew suspicious when Thredd began receiving regular visits after years without any. The sealed description is being investigated to learn the visitor's purpose.

faq.q: Where does this sealed document need to be taken?
faq.answer: Take the document first to city architect Baros Alexston in Stormwind. After examining the unfamiliar description, Alexston directs you to deliver it to Master Mathias Shaw at SI:7 headquarters in Old Town.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see how false names, forged papers, and visits to a prison cell drew Mathias Shaw's attention when he compared the man's appearance with SI:7 intelligence.
As an Alliance member, you can see the weakness in Stormwind's security: conspirators can pass through the Stockade's gates with falsified credentials.
